newsitem.title: USA: Cyrix stock falls; warns of lower sales and a loss.
newsitem.headline: Cyrix stock falls; warns of lower sales and a loss.

text.p: The stock of Cyrix Corp. tumbled Tuesday after the maker of computer microprocessors warned that it would report a big drop in sales and a loss for the latest quarter.
In early morning trading on the Nasdaq, Cyrix was off $2.125 at $19.25.
The Richardson, Texas-based company said late Monday that it expected revenues to be "significantly below" the $75.6 million reported in the first quarter this year.
It blamed the drop on weak demand and price pressure.
In last year's second quarter, Cyrix lost $16.422 million, or 81 cents a share, on revenues of $25.1 million.
